before-starting-fallen-from-grace-or-aft.text: Baldwin raises his eyebrows at you, but otherwise ignores you.

after-completing-fallen-from-grace.npc: So the Angel has gone then? It's so hard to believe after all this time...

after-completing-fallen-from-grace.player: I suppose it will be nice to not need to worry about her anymore.

after-completing-fallen-from-grace.npc: Perhaps... Though she was meant to keep us safe. We'll now need to hope no other danger comes along.

after-completing-fallen-from-grace.player: Well, if that does happen, there are other ways to defend yourselves.
